related.title: TCP Fast Open：冷暖連線與重播語意
related.titleEn: TCP Fast Open: cold/warm connections and replay semantics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受唯一資料10000/12000 B且按DSN順序交付，未完成區間保持待補。 交接時須能核對：交付 mptcp-mapping.csv、重疊圖及重新注入不重複交付測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require10000/12000 unique bytes delivered in DSN order, leaving incomplete ranges pending. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver mptcp-mapping.csv, overlap diagrams and reinjection deduplication tests.
related.difference: 分開冷啟動無cookie、暖連線有效cookie與伺服器拒絕TFO三種時間圖。
related.differenceEn: Draw cold no-cookie, warm valid-cookie and server-rejected TFO timelines separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
MPTCP在子流TCP序號之外維持資料序號映射；重新注入資料不能重複交付應用。
教學基準：6000+6000-2000 = 10000 unique B；對照：6000+6000 = 12000 unique B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

TFO可在特定條件將資料放入SYN，但cookie、伺服器政策及重播語意影響可用性。
教學基準：2*80 = 160 ms；對照：1*80 = 80 ms。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
MPTCP maintains data-sequence mappings beyond subflow TCP sequence numbers; reinjected data must not be delivered twice.
Teaching baseline: 6000+6000-2000 = 10000 unique B; comparison: 6000+6000 = 12000 unique B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

TFO can carry SYN data under specific conditions, but cookies, server policy and replay semantics constrain use.
Teaching baseline: 2*80 = 160 ms; comparison: 1*80 = 80 ms. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Record origin, alternate host/port, protocol ID, receipt time and ma without replacing the origin identity.
